reason: No cited evidence is provided to support any of the key premises. The claims about defect introduction, energy barrier modification, and their effects on magnetocaloric response and hysteresis are entirely unsupported by prior observations.
premises: He⁺ ion irradiation introduces point defects and dislocation loops in FeMnNiGeSi HEAs
Defects lower the energy barrier for the first-order magnetostructural transition
Lowered energy barrier smooths the magnetocaloric response and reduces hysteresis
Defect engineering effects are distinct from compositional tuning
An optimal irradiation dose window exists below amorphization/degradation thresholds
